result.meaning: TemperatureCVAE versus nominal temperature; thermal units only, not other professions

response_types.diagnosis: ONE explanatory string, never a list

prompt.rule_count_policy: Choose at most three conditions, not one per profession. Four rules is invalid.

domains.rules: 0..3 ordered rules; each has exactly signal, threshold, action
domains.threshold: ONE NUMBER from the signal threshold domain

semantics.thermal_disagreement: abs(history-nominalTemp)/20; thermal only, not calibrated uncertainty
semantics.contact_heat: max(measuredContactTemp-60,0)/30; electrical only, not supply availability
semantics.verified_sensor_bias: Previously valid reference comparison above1degC; control only
semantics.rules: First rule with a qualifying candidate; return_tour selects next tour item; other actions rank qualifying candidates.
semantics.signal_action: Typed signal times public asset weight divided by completion cost
semantics.fallback: tour returns to baseline; ppo uses the frozen trained actor if no rule matches.
semantics.tool_use: refresh_s changes actual CVAE calls; cooldown applies only to optional detours.

constraints: Fixed qualification, complete return certificate, two detours per owned round and measured-task semantics.
No changes to hidden evaluator, weights, data, costs or budgets; no source code.
Raw truth, onset and test results are not provided. Development accept/rollback feedback is available.
Do not repeat the current workflow. Return JSON only; diagnosis and expected_effect1..500characters.
